description: Start a background logcat watcher. Lines accumulate in a ring buffer. Use adb_logcat_poll to retrieve new entries.

bufferSize.description: Max lines to keep in ring buffer (100-50000, default 2000)

tag.description: Filter by tag (e.g., 'MyApp'). Must match /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/ — Android tags are identifier-shaped in practice.

name: adb_logcat_start
